chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Fadl al-Yamani, who said:

A multitude descended upon al-Ja'fari from the family of Ja'far, and he had no ability to face them. So he wrote to Abu Muhammad عليه السلام complaining of that. He عليه السلام wrote to him: “You will be spared that, if Allah, Exalted is He, wills.” Then he went out against them with a small band, while the people numbered more than twenty thousand, and he was with fewer than a thousand, and he overcame them.

key_terms.إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: if Allah, Exalted is He, so wills
key_terms.الْجَعْفَرِيِّ: a man affiliated with the family of Ja'far
key_terms.تُكْفَوْنَ: you will be spared, protected, or sufficed against it
key_terms.يَشْكُو: he complains or conveys his distress

ai.seo_question: How does this narration describe the support and guidance of Abu Muhammad عليه السلام in a time of military danger?
ai.summary: This report narrates that a member of the family of Ja'far faced an overwhelming hostile force and sought help from Abu Muhammad عليه السلام. After receiving his reassuring reply, he confronted the much larger army with a small group and prevailed, highlighting the Imam's guidance and the role of divine will in deliverance.
